item.title: Some Clouds And Chilly Tonight
item.description: Weather Update: Friday, December 19 — We spent all of Friday under the influence of a polar continental high pressure. It was moving through the Ohio Valley. the High now is settling into the Smokies of East Tennessee. That will allow winds to switch directions from the south this evening. Temps will fall steadily at first, down to around freezing....
